objective: 把测试开发专家提出的 AI 测试指标、能力前置、LLM/RAG/Judge/Agent 压测、AI 辅助测试、Skill/MCP、Benchmark 与数据标注要求，转成可被 factory 和 course 消费的证据化专业能力合同。
input_scope: 用户在 2026-08-12 提供的专业测试开发建议
用户提供的《AI测试开发工程师能力模型与成长路径》本地文档（SHA-256 固定）
用户提供的《AI Agent 测试架构方案 v2.0》本地文档（SHA-256 固定）
当前 85 个公开课程页面
标准、官方文档、主要研究论文和工具官方文档
research_questions: AI 测试的通用质量维度、任务指标、系统指标与业务指标应如何分层？
新人从传统测试到 LLM、RAG、Judge、Agent、性能与质量平台应如何递进？
AI 生成测试用例如何通过 Prompt、独立 Oracle、Eval、Mutation 和人审证明真正提效？
Agent 压测应如何定义 workload、trace、指标、故障注入、停止条件和报告？
Skill 与 MCP 如何处理冲突、解耦、跨平台适配、权限、副作用和可验证接入？
当前课程哪些内容已充分覆盖、哪些只覆盖名词、哪些缺失或不可执行？
职业能力如何用可验证工件分级，而不是用年限、P 级或影响力计数替代？
Agent 评估系统、长时程可靠性、多 Agent 交接、人类接管与供应链安全应如何成为可验证合同？
CAIA、飞书 MCP、Web Coding 三个术语的可验证含义是什么？

excluded_from_authoritative_claims: AI authorship detector score used as proof

freshness_policy.standards: verify current edition and publication date
freshness_policy.tooling: official docs current as of research date; recheck before implementation
freshness_policy.benchmarks: record harness and dataset versions; leaderboard claims expire with version changes
freshness_policy.productivity: treat each study as population- and task-bounded, never universal

stop_conditions: An ambiguous term has no authoritative definition: mark UNKNOWN and request owner clarification.
A metric has no task, slice, threshold owner, oracle or failure action: keep the course unit BLOCKED.
A tool example has no executable fixture, manifest and receipt: do not claim it is usable.
Fixture evidence is presented as live, practitioner, integration or production evidence: fail closed.
An AI-generated artifact evaluates or approves itself without an independent oracle or human gate: fail closed.
maturity_boundary: Research and local fixture evidence only. No live model, enterprise integration, practitioner review, production validation or publication approval is produced by this plan.
